data.gender_notes: Dayita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dayita is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'daya', which means 'compassion' or 'mercy'. The suffix 'ita' means 'loved by'. Thus, Dayita signifies 'loved by God' or 'beloved of the gods'. The name Dayita carries the meaning “Loved by God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dayita usually hope their child will grow to embody loved by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
